get.summary: Lists every skill group with its skills, in display order.

200.description: All groups with both names and their skills.

post.summary: Creates a skill group with its skills.
post.description:
The German name is required. Skills keep the given order; a name may appear only once per
group (ignoring case), and a "since year" must lie between 1950 and 2100.

201.description: Created; Location points to the new group.

400.description:
A field breaks a rule; the errors are keyed by field (de.name, skills,
            skills.sinceYear).

get.summary: Reads one skill group for the editor.

200.description: The group with both names and its skills.

put.summary: Replaces a skill group's names, position and skills.
put.description: Full replacement: the skills are replaced by the given list in its order.

400.description: A field breaks a rule; the errors are keyed by field.

delete.summary: Deletes a skill group with all its skills.

get.summary: Lists every project, including hidden ones, in display order.

200.description: All projects with both locales, decisions and images.

post.summary: Creates a project with its decisions and images.
post.description:
German title and teaser are required; en: null creates the project without English
texts. The slug must be unique. At most five visible projects can be featured at a time.
Every image must reference a public image document (PNG, JPEG, WebP).

201.description: Created; Location points to the new project.

400.description:
A field breaks a rule; the errors are keyed by field (slug, status,
            de.title, images).

409.description: The slug is already used, or five visible projects are already featured.

get.summary: Reads one project for the editor.

200.description: The project with both locales, decisions and images.

put.summary: Replaces a project, its decisions and its images.
put.description:
Full replacement: decisions and images are replaced by the given lists in their order;
en: null removes the English texts. Keeping the project's own slug is not a conflict.

400.description: A field breaks a rule; the errors are keyed by field.

409.description:
The slug is used by another project, or five visible projects are already
            featured.

delete.summary: Deletes a project with its texts, decisions and image references.
delete.description:
The image documents themselves stay; delete them separately. To take a project off the site
without losing it, set isVisible to false instead.

get.summary: Reads the complete profile for the editor, including phone and street address.
get.description:
de always carries the German texts. en is null when no English text exists yet;
a single empty English field means that field falls back to German on the open site.

put.summary: Replaces the complete profile with the given one.
put.description:
Full replacement: send everything GET returned, changed where needed. German title line
and headline are required; en: null or English fields left empty remove the English
texts, which then fall back to German. The fact bar is replaced in the given order (at most
four cells). photoDocumentId must name a public image document or be null.

400.description:
A field breaks a rule; the errors are keyed by field (de.headline, facts,
            photoDocumentId).

get.summary: Lists both legal pages with both locales, Impressum first.
Reads one legal page for the editor.

200.description: The page with both locales and their "last updated" stamps.

put.summary: Replaces the texts of a legal page.
put.description:
German title and body are required; en: null removes the English texts, which then
fall back to German. Only a locale whose text actually changed gets a new "last updated"
stamp, so saving unchanged texts never moves the date the privacy page shows.

400.description:
A field breaks a rule (de.title, de.bodyMarkdown) or the key is not
            supported.

get.summary: Lists every interest, including hidden ones, in page order.

post.description:
The German title and a known kind are required; en: null creates the interest without
English texts, which then fall back to German. The image must be a public image document.

201.description: Created; Location points to the new interest.

400.description:
A field breaks a rule; the errors are keyed by field (kind, imageDocumentId,
            de.title).

get.summary: Reads one interest for the editor.

put.summary: Replaces an interest with the given fields.
put.description: Full replacement: fields left out are cleared. en: null removes the English texts.

400.description: A field breaks a rule; the errors are keyed by field.

delete.summary: Deletes an interest with its translations; its image stays in the documents.
delete.description: To take an interest off the site without losing it, set isVisible to false instead.

get.summary: Lists every document, newest first.

post.description:
Multipart form with file, kind, visibility and optional labelDe /
labelEn. The content type is detected from the file's first bytes; the name and the type
the browser sends are ignored. Allowed: PDF, PNG, JPEG, WebP up to 10 MB. Photos and images must
be images; certificates and cover letters must be link-only. Images are not resized: upload them
in web size.

201.description: Stored; Location points to the content of the new document.

400.description:
The file is empty, too large or of a type not allowed, or kind and visibility do not fit
            (file, visibility).

413.description: The request is larger than a 10 MB file allows.

put.summary: Changes the labels and the visibility of a document.
put.description:
The file itself never changes; upload a new document instead. A document shown on the open site
(profile photo, project or interest image) cannot be made link-only, and certificates and cover
letters can never be made public.

400.description: The visibility breaks a kind rule.

409.description: The document is shown on the open site and would become link-only.

delete.summary: Deletes a document and its file.
delete.description:
A document still used by the profile, a project, an interest or an application link cannot be
            deleted.

409.description: The document is still in use.

get.summary: Downloads any document, public or link-only, as an attachment.

200.description: The file with its original name.

get.summary: Lists every education entry, including hidden ones, newest first.

post.description:
The German degree is required; en: null creates the entry without English texts. The
grade is free text ("1,8", "gut") of at most 40 characters.

201.description: Created; Location points to the new entry.

400.description:
A field breaks a rule; the errors are keyed by field (institution, endDate,
            de.degree).

get.summary: Reads one education entry for the editor.

put.summary: Replaces an education entry with the given fields.
put.description: Full replacement: fields left out are cleared. en: null removes the English texts.

400.description: A field breaks a rule; the errors are keyed by field.

delete.summary: Deletes an education entry with its translations.
delete.description: To take an entry off the site without losing it, set isVisible to false instead.

get.summary: Lists every career station, including hidden ones, newest first.

post.description:
The German role title is required; en: null creates the station without English texts,
which then fall back to German. An end date before the start date is rejected; a null end
date marks the current station.

201.description: Created; Location points to the new station.

400.description:
A field breaks a rule; the errors are keyed by field (company, endDate,
            de.roleTitle).

get.summary: Reads one career station for the editor.

put.summary: Replaces a career station with the given fields.
put.description: Full replacement: fields left out are cleared. en: null removes the English texts.

400.description: A field breaks a rule; the errors are keyed by field.

delete.summary: Deletes a career station with its translations.
delete.description: To take a station off the site without losing it, set isVisible to false instead.

get.summary: Lists the links of an application, newest first.
get.description: The clear tokens are not part of the list; they exist only in the response that created a link.

post.summary: Creates a link and returns its token once.
post.description:
The token is 128 random bits in base64url; the link's public path is /b/{token}. Only
its SHA-256 is stored, so this response is the only chance to copy it. Without
expiresAt the link expires after 90 days. Only link-only documents can be attached.

201.description: Created; the body carries the token, Location points to the link.

400.description:
A setting breaks a rule (profile, expiresAt, greetingDe,
            documentIds).

get.summary: Reads one link of an application.

404.description: The application has no link with this id.

put.summary: Replaces the settings and documents of a link.
put.description: The token stays the same. A revoked link cannot be changed; create a new one instead.

404.description: The application has no link with this id.

post.description:
From now on the link answers 404 like one that never existed. Revoking is final and
idempotent; the link and its statistics stay visible in the admin area.

404.description: The application has no link with this id.

get.summary: Lists every application, newest first.

post.description: Company, position and a known status are required; the job ad must be an absolute http(s) URL.

201.description: Created; Location points to the new application.

400.description:
A field breaks a rule; the errors are keyed by field (company, status,
            jobAdUrl).

get.summary: Reads one application.

put.summary: Replaces an application with the given fields.
put.description: Full replacement: fields left out are cleared. The links of the application are not touched.

400.description: A field breaks a rule; the errors are keyed by field.

delete.summary: Deletes an application with its links and their statistics.
delete.description: The links stop working at once. The attached documents stay; they belong to the documents area.

get.summary: Reads the statistics page.
get.description:
The status pipeline with a count per status, the response rate (every status except
Draft counts as sent; reply, interview, offer and rejection count as a response) and per
application its links' openings, downloads and the time from the first link to the first
opening. Built from link events, which carry no visitor data.

An application link in the admin area. The clear token is not part of it; it exists only once, at

profile.description: The audience the link is made for; decides the section order.

greetingEn.description: Optional one-line English greeting; the German one is used when empty.

expiresAt.description: Must lie in the future; null sets it to 90 days from now.

responseRate.description: Responded divided by sent, from 0 to 1; null when nothing was sent.

pipeline.description: Every status in pipeline order with its count, zeros included.

applications.description: The activity per application, newest application first.

StatusCount.description: The number of applications in one status.

ApplicationActivity.description: What happened on the links of one application.

minutesToFirstOpen.description: Whole minutes from the first link's creation to the first opening, or null.
